edits.new: Then "U-7304", who holds the A letter, makes the same call and the response is 201 with state "ROLLED_BACK"

edits.old: Then GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/version-rollbacks/{rollbackId} answers the same seven fields and the statement that decisions taken from 15 December 2026 use version "ENTRY-2026.11"
edits.new:
Then GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/version-rollbacks/{rollbackId} answers the same seven fields and the statement that decisions taken from 15 December 2026 use version "ENTRY-2026.11"

  Scenario: AC7 The reason is read as 20 to 1000 characters and the answer state is ROLLED_BACK (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "U-7301" rolls back "ENTRY-2026.12" to "ENTRY-2026.11" with an immediate date
    When the call is made with a reason of 1001 characters
    Then the response is 422 with message MSG-GEN-001 and its detail names "reason", and the rwb-decision contract fake records no call
    When the call is made with a reason of 1000 characters
    Then the response is 201 with state "ROLLED_BACK", the reason reaches the rwb-decision contract fake unchanged, and "rwb.access.events.v1" holds no message for the rollback

  Scenario: AC8 A call without caller credentials is answered 401 and an unknown rollback id is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given no caller credentials are sent
    When a call is made to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/version-rollbacks with targetKind "RULE", targetId "ENTRY-2026.12", previousVersionId "ENTRY-2026.11" and effectiveDate 15 December 2026
    Then the response is 401 and the rwb-decision contract fake records no call
    When "U-7301" calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/version-rollbacks/{rollbackId} with a rollbackId that does not exist
    Then the response is 404
